title: 3.12.3: Formula Review
originalText:
Formula Review

3.4 Rational Numbers

\(\frac{a}{c}±\frac{b}{c}=\unsupported{mfrac}{a±}\frac{b}{c}\)

\(\frac{a}{b}×\frac{c}{d}=\frac{a×c}{b×d}\)

\(\frac{a}{b}×\frac{c}{d}=\frac{a×c}{b×d}\frac{a}{b}÷\frac{c}{d}=\frac{a}{d}×\frac{d}{c}=\frac{a×d}{b×c}\)

3.5 Irrational Numbers

\(\sqrt{a×b}=\sqrt{a}×\sqrt{b}\)

\(a×x±b×x=(a±b)×x\)

\(\sqrt{a}÷\sqrt{b}=\frac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{b}}=\sqrt{\frac{a}{b}}\)

\({a}^{2}−{b}^{2}=(a−b)(a+b)\)

3.6 Real Numbers

\(a×(b+c)=a×b+a×c\)

\(a+b=b+a\)

\(a×b=b×a\)

\(a+(b+c)=(a+b)+c\)

\(a×(b×c)=(a×b)×c\)

\(a+0=a\)

\(a×1=a\)

\(a+(−a)=0\)

\(a×(\frac{1}{a})=1\)

3.8 Exponents

\({a}^{n}{a}^{m}={a}^{n+}\unsupported{msup}{m}\)

\(\frac{{a}^{n}}{{a}^{m}}={a}^{(n−m)}\)

\({a}^{0}=1\), provided that \(a≠0\)

\({(a×b)}^{n}={a}^{n}×{b}^{n}\)

\({(\frac{a}{b})}^{n}=\frac{{a}^{n}}{{b}^{n}}\)

\({({a}^{n})}^{m}={a}^{(n×m)}\)

\({a}^{−n}=\frac{1}{{a}^{n}}\), provided that \(a≠0\)

3.10 Arithmetic Sequences

\({a}_{i}={a}_{1}+d×(i−1)\)

\(d=\unsupported{mfrac}{{a}_{j}−{a}_{i}j−i}\)

\({a}_{1}={a}_{i}−d(i−1)\)

\({s}_{n}=n(\unsupported{mfrac}{{a}_{1}+{a}_{n}2})\)

3.11 Geometric Sequences

\({a}_{n}={a}_{1}{r}^{n}\unsupported{msup}{−}\unsupported{msup}{1}\)

\({s}_{n}={a}_{1}(\frac{1−{r}^{n−1}}{1−r})\)

3.11 Geometric Sequences

\({a}_{n}={a}_{1}{r}^{n}\unsupported{msup}{−}\unsupported{msup}{1}\)

\({s}_{n}={a}_{1}(\frac{1−{r}^{n−1}}{1−r})\)
